mapper.sql: s.id, s.name, s.source_type, s.git_url, s.git_branch, s.git_commit, s.root_path, s.credential_enc, s.credential_user, s.status, s.last_error, s.last_indexed_at, s.last_index_ms, round(extract(epoch from (now() - s.updated_at)) * 1000) AS elapsed_ms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_knowledge_document d WHERE d.source_id = s.id) AS document_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_knowledge_chunk c JOIN ai_knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.source_id = s.id) AS chunk_count, s.index_total_files, s.index_processed_files, s.index_skipped_files, round(extract(epoch from (now() - COALESCE(s.index_heartbeat_at, s.updated_at))) * 1000) AS heartbeat_elapsed_ms, s.index_current_file, s.created_by, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_knowledge_source s WHERE s.id = #{id}
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_knowledge_source WHERE created_by = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_source (id, name, source_type, git_url, git_branch, root_path, credential_enc, credential_user, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{sourceType}, #{gitUrl}, #{gitBranch}, #{rootPath}, #{credentialEnc}, #{credentialUser}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET status = #{status}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, index_heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, index_current_file = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET status = 'INDEXING', last_error = NULL, index_total_files = #{totalFiles}, index_processed_files = 0, index_skipped_files = 0, index_current_file = NULL, index_heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET index_processed_files = #{processedFiles}, index_skipped_files = #{skippedFiles}, index_current_file = #{currentFile}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET status = #{status}, git_commit = #{gitCommit}, last_error = NULL, last_indexed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_index_ms = #{durationMs}, index_heartbeat_at = NULL, index_current_file = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{error}, index_heartbeat_at = NULL, index_current_file = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET index_heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{reason}, index_heartbeat_at = NULL, index_current_file = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'INDEXING') AND COALESCE(index_heartbeat_at, updated_at) < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{graceSeconds} * interval '1 second')
